simple.prompt: Verbal substitution with 'do so': 'Management asked him to resign, and after consulting counsel, he ___.'
simple.explanation: 'Do so' (atau did so) adalah bentuk substitusi formal untuk menggantikan verba dan komplemennya yang sudah disebutkan ('to resign').

simple.prompt: Clausal substitution with 'so': 'Will the new tax regulation take effect next fiscal quarter? The minister believes ___.'
simple.explanation: Substitusi klausa positif dengan kata kerja keyakinan/pikiran (believe, think, hope): 'believes so'.

simple.targetSentence: She ordered the salmon and her husband the steak.
simple.explanation: She ordered the salmon and her husband (ellipsis: ordered) the steak.
hints: Elipsis kata kerja: 'and her husband the steak'.

simple.prompt: Clausal substitution with 'not': 'Is there any risk of a default? The central bank governor hopes ___.'
simple.explanation: Substitusi klausa negatif dengan kata kerja 'hope', 'afraid', 'suppose': 'hopes not' (berharap tidak terjadi default).

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat substitusi nominal dengan 'the former' dan 'the latter'.
simple.targetSentence: Gold and silver are precious the former is more valuable.
simple.explanation: Gold and silver are precious the former is more valuable.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Gold and silver are precious'.
Substitusi entitas pertama: 'the former is more valuable'.

simple.prompt: Nominal substitution with 'one/ones': 'The revised proposal is far superior to the previous ___.'
simple.explanation: 'One' menggantikan kata benda tunggal yang dapat dihitung ('proposal') yang telah disebutkan sebelumnya.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat elipsis predikat dengan auxiliary 'did'.
simple.targetSentence: He promised to complete the report and indeed he did.
simple.explanation: He promised to complete the report + and indeed he did (ellipsis: completed it).
hints: Mulai dengan 'He promised to complete the report'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog substitusi verba formal dalam riset ilmiah.
dialogue: Did the control group adhere to the caloric protocol?
intermediate.explanation: 'Did so' merepresentasikan pemenuhan protokol tindakan dalam tulisan ilmiah.

intermediate.prompt: Ellipsis after to-infinitive (infinitival ellipsis): 'You may inspect the confidential archives if you wish ___.'
intermediate.explanation: Infinitival ellipsis (menghilangkan verb phrase dan hanya mempertahankan partikel 'to'): 'if you wish to' (= wish to inspect).

intermediate.prompt: Gapping ellipsis: 'The first cohort received placebo injections; the second, ___ dosages.'
intermediate.explanation: Gapping: kata kerja utama 'received' dihilangkan pada klausa kedua dan digantikan tanda koma (the second, therapeutic dosages).

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat substitusi klausal formal 'if so'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Are there any further amendments if so submit them now.
intermediate.explanation: Are there any further amendments + if so submit them now.
hints: Mulai dengan pertanyaan: 'Are there any further amendments'.
Kondisi substitusi: 'if so submit them now'.

intermediate.prompt: Negative conditional ellipsis: 'Is funding guaranteed? If ___, alternative sponsors must be found.'
intermediate.explanation: 'If not' adalah bentuk elipsis baku untuk 'If funding is not guaranteed'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan infinitival ellipsis 'afford to'.
intermediate.targetSentence: We would like to acquire the patent but cannot afford to.
intermediate.explanation: We would like to acquire the patent + but cannot afford to (ellipsis: acquire it).
hints: Mulai dengan 'We would like to acquire the patent'.

dialogue: Can the seller guarantee debt indemnity?
They explicitly agreed ___ in yesterday's pre-closing protocol.
intermediate.explanation: Agree + to-infinitive + verbal substitution 'do so': 'agreed to do so'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi ketidaktepatan substitusi 'do so' dengan kata kerja stative/keadaan.
complex.draft: She liked the historical architecture of Florence, and her colleagues did so too.
options: She liked the historical architecture of Florence, and her colleagues did too.
She liked the architecture of Florence, and her colleagues done so too.
She liked the architecture of Florence, and her colleagues made so too.
complex.explanation: 'Do so' HANYA dapat menggantikan kata kerja aksi dinamis (dynamic actions). Untuk stative verbs seperti 'like / know / believe', gunakan elipsis auxiliary standar: 'and her colleagues did too' (bukan did so too).
hints: 'Do so' tidak boleh dipakai untuk kata kerja keadaan (stative verbs).

complex.prompt: Linguistic differentiation: What separates 'Ellipsis' from 'Substitution' in cohesive discourse (Halliday & Hasan, 1976)?
options: Ellipsis is substitution by zero (leaving a blank space); Substitution replaces an item with an explicit counter-token (one, do so, so).
Ellipsis is only written; Substitution is only spoken.
complex.explanation: Menurut Halliday & Hasan, elipsis adalah penggantian oleh kekosongan (substitution by zero / omission), sedangkan substitusi mengganti unsur leksikal dengan kata pengganti nyata seperti 'one', 'do so', atau 'so'.
hints: Konsep Halliday & Hasan mengenai penggantian nol vs token pengganti nyata.
Pilih opsi Ellipsis is substitution by zero.

complex.prompt: Pseudogapping in formal comparative prose: 'The central bank monitored currency markets more vigilantly than the treasury ___ equity markets.'
complex.explanation: Pseudogapping menyisakan auxiliary 'did' sebelum objek kontras ('equity markets'): 'more vigilantly than the treasury did equity markets'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat akademik elipsis komparatif formal.
complex.targetSentence: Higher inflation rates eroded consumer purchasing power as did rising interest rates.
complex.explanation: Higher inflation rates eroded consumer purchasing power + as did rising interest rates.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Higher inflation rates eroded consumer purchasing power'.
Elipsis komparatif terbalik: 'as did rising interest rates'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan repetisi kata yang seharusnya di-elipsis secara elegan.
complex.draft: Some pharmaceutical companies developed vaccines, while other pharmaceutical companies developed diagnostic kits.
options: Some pharmaceutical companies developed vaccines, while others developed diagnostic kits.
Some pharmaceutical companies developed vaccines, and other ones developed kits.
Some pharmaceutical companies developed vaccines, while other companies did so kits.
complex.explanation: Pengulangan canggung 'pharmaceutical companies' dihindari dengan substitusi pronominal elegan: 'while others developed diagnostic kits'.
hints: Gunakan 'others' untuk menghindari repetisi frasa yang sama.
Pilih kalimat dengan 'while others developed diagnostic kits'.

complex.prompt: Select the sentence with flawless ellipsis in coordinated clauses:
options: The senior diplomats favored compromise; the junior military officers, decisive confrontation.
The senior diplomats favored compromise, the junior military officers did compromise.
The diplomats favored compromise; junior officers decisive.
complex.explanation: Struktur gapping klasik: kata kerja 'favored' dihilangkan pada klausa kedua dan digantikan oleh koma yang anggun diapit titik koma.
hints: Gapping klasik dengan titik koma dan koma pengganti verba.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog perdebatan doktrin yudisial mahkamah agung.
dialogue: Does the appellant seek to overturn the 1974 precedent?
The appellant has not explicitly requested to, but their legal reasoning effectively ___.
complex.explanation: 'Their legal reasoning effectively does so' menggantikan verba aksi 'overturns the precedent' secara presisi.
